history.summary: Gaudiya Vaishnava temple of ISKCON, the Hare Krishna movement founded by A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada in 1966, at R-11/35 Hare Krishna Marg, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad. Reviews note it is popular during Rash Mela. Founding date of this specific temple was not found in published sources (verify).

name: ISKCON Ghaziabad
town_description: Ghaziabad is a large industrial city in western Uttar Pradesh on Delhi's eastern edge, part of the National Capital Region; its planned townships of Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar and Vaishali mix dense residential sectors with markets, parks and neighbourhood temples.

travel.airport: Nearest airport: Delhi IGI Airport (DEL), roughly an hour's drive (verify)
travel.railway: Nearest major station: Ghaziabad Junction (GZB), a short drive away (verify)
travel.road: R-11/35 Hare Krishna Marg, Block 11, Raj Nagar; accessible by road from Delhi via NH-9; parking can be tight on Janmashtami

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Janmashtami is the peak festival
visitor_information.opening_hours: Daily 4:30 am - 1:00 pm and 4:15 pm - 9:00 pm (per local listing; verify on iskconghaziabad.com)
